command.hemalurgy.vision.notify: Your hemalurgy vision has been turned %s
config.hemalurgy.allomanticPewterSpiritw: Extra spiritweb integrity granted when an Allomantic pewter spike is equipped in the linchpin slot. This stacks with the pewter spike's own spiritweb bonus.
config.hemalurgy.feruchemicalGoldSpiritw: Extra spiritweb integrity granted when a Feruchemical gold spike is equipped in the linchpin slot. This stacks with the gold spike's own spiritweb bonus.
config.hemalurgy.integrityCheckTick.desc: How often, in ticks, the mod checks whether a player's spiritweb is still intact. Lower values react faster to missing spikes but cost slightly more performance. There are 20 ticks in one second.
config.hemalurgy.linchpinSpikeSpiritwebB: Spiritweb integrity bonus granted while a linchpin spike is equipped. Linchpin spikes occupy a special slot and grant this bonus on top of their metal's own spiritweb bonus.
config.hemalurgy.maxSpikesPerEntity.desc: The maximum number of spikes that can be embedded in a single target at once. Once reached, no more spikes can be placed until some are removed.
config.hemalurgy.spike.maxStrength.desc: The maximum strength this spike can store from a killed target. Strength determines how much power or attribute the spike grants. Set to 0 for no cap.
config.hemalurgy.spike.spiritwebBonus.de: Spiritweb integrity bonus granted while this spike is equipped. Positive values make your spiritweb harder to damage; negative values weaken it.
config.hemalurgy.spike.stealMultiplier.d: Scales how much power or attribute this spike steals from a killed target. 1.0 steals the normal amount, below 1.0 steals less, and above 1.0 steals more.
config.hemalurgy.spikeAttackDamage.desc: The bonus melee attack damage a spike item adds when held in the main or off hand. Defaults to 0 so spikes rely on placement and removal damage percentages. This does not affect the damage dealt when placing or removing spikes.
config.hemalurgy.spikeCooldownTicks.desc: How long, in ticks, a spike item must wait after piercing a target before it can be used again. There are 20 ticks in one second, so 1200 ticks equals one minute.
config.hemalurgy.spikeDamage.desc: Flat damage dealt to the target when a spike is placed on them. This is separate from the percent-based placement damage.
config.hemalurgy.spikePierceThreshold.de: The percentage of maximum health a target must be below for you to pierce them with a spike. Targets below this percentage of their max health can be spiked. Set to 100 to allow spiking full-health targets.
config.hemalurgy.spikePlaceDamagePercent: Damage dealt as a percentage of the target's maximum health when a spike is placed. Higher values make spiking more lethal.
config.hemalurgy.spikeRemoveDamagePercen: Damage dealt as a percentage of the target's maximum health when a spike is removed. Higher values make removal riskier.
config.hemalurgy.spikeRemoveHealthThresh: A target must be at or below this percentage of their maximum health for you to remove a spike by right-clicking. This prevents removing spikes from healthy targets.
